result.title: Draft Forcing: Target-guided Speculative Drafting and Learned Verifier for Autoregressive Video Generation
result.summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models enable streaming synthesis chunk by chunk, yet invoking the large model for every chunk remains costly. While chunk-level speculative decoding can offload chunks to a lightweight draft model, existing approaches suffer from two limitations: (1) an off-the-shelf draft diverges from the target's trajectory, compounding errors in history; and (2) they either omit verification or rely on costly post-decode aesthetic scores rather than verifying consistency against the target. We address both with Draft Forcing, a framework coupling target-guided drafting with an on-policy trained verifier. Specifically, to align the draft for high acceptance, we opt for feature-level drafting, conditioning it on multi-layer target hidden states persisted from committed chunks, whose outputs are pushed to match target trajectories with multi-aspect losses. For verification, we propose an on-policy trained feature-space verifier predicting CDF-calibrated frame-wise relative RMSE against the target. It is trained on speculative rollouts as contexts anneal from random to inference-aligned mixtures, and gates proposals without VAE decoding. On the 14B Self-Forcing target, Draft Forcing achieves $1.63\times$ DiT and $1.57\times$ end-to-end speedups on VBench with minimal quality loss, and up to $1.93\times$ DiT ($1.82\times$ end-to-end) when combined with orthogonal KV compression. It generalizes to accelerate a streaming variant of MiniMax-H3, generating over $50\%$ draft frames with competitive quality.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Draft Forcing，用于自回归视频扩散的分块推测解码：以目标模型多层隐状态为条件的特征级草稿模型产生候选块，并用 on-policy 训练的特征空间验证器按 CDF 校准的逐帧相对 RMSE 门控提案，无需 VAE 解码，在 14B Self-Forcing 上获得约 1.6 倍加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「草稿—验证—门控」以及复用已提交块的隐状态、在特征空间做免解码一致性校验，可能为 latent 推理中的候选状态筛选与采纳/停止决策提供方法线索，但面向视频生成，迁移可行性待核查。
